jobs.title: Strategic Advisor - Environmental Due Diligence (Phase I/Phase II/PCA)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly experienced Strategic Advisor specializing in Environmental Due Diligence (Phase I ESA and PCA) to guide the development of Inspectli’s AI\-driven software platform. In this advisory role, you will not be conducting field investigations or writing reports. Instead, you will act as the bridge between ground truth industry expertise and our engineering team. Your insights will shape how our software automates data extraction, ensures regulatory compliance, and meets the rigorous risk\-tolerance standards of commercial lenders and engineering firms.

**Responsibilities**

* Review and pressure\-test automated Phase I ESA and PCA outputs generated by our software to ensure they meet or exceed industry expectations.
* Advise our engineering team on the practical nuances of ASTM E1527 and E2018 compliance, identifying potential real\-world pitfalls in automated data extraction (e.g., EDR data, historical city directories).
* Provide strategic insight into the commercial lender perspective, defining exactly what risk officers care about when reviewing due diligence reports.
* Help prioritize our product roadmap by identifying the most significant workflow bottlenecks and manual pain points in traditional report writing.
* Act as a sounding board for new feature development, effectively translating environmental risk concepts into actionable guidance for software engineers.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 7 to 10\+ years of direct experience in the environmental due diligence space, specifically conducting, reviewing, or managing Phase I ESAs and PCAs.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep, practical knowledge of ASTM E1527 and E2018 standards and environmental risk assessment practices.
* **Tech\-Curious:** You do not need to write code or possess advanced software skills (e.g., GIS/AutoCAD), but you must be interested in modern tech solutions and AI workflows. You should be naturally curious about how automation can improve industry standards.
* **Communication:** Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate remotely and bridge the gap between environmental science and tech development.
* **Background:** Current or previous experience as a Senior Consultant, Environmental Risk Officer at a commercial lender, or a Digital Transformation lead at an engineering firm is highly preferred.

**Compensation \& Role Structure**

*Please Note: This is a flexible, early\-stage advisory role compensated via equity/commission rather than a traditional salaried W\-2 position. It requires a low time commitment and is designed for an industry veteran looking for an impactful, strategic challenge alongside their current work.*

Pay: $100\.00 \- $150\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
